cases.answer: A window resize event only fires when the viewport changes. A sidebar collapsing or a web font loading can resize a card while the window stays the same size. ResizeObserver reports that element's own size change.

cases.answer: If teams release on their own schedules and the shared parts are stable, I'd publish a versioned package with semantic versioning, changelogs and a deprecation policy, so each team upgrades when it is ready. If the teams are tightly coupled and change things together, a monorepo makes atomic changes easier, but it needs clear ownership and CI that only runs the affected suites.

cases.answer: Mark a known good commit and the current bad commit, then let get dissect check out the midpoint, run the test, mark it good or bad, and repeat until it finds the first bad commit. You can automate it with get dissect run and a script whose exit code says good or bad, but the test has to be reproducible.
